`send_receipt` in `services/notifier/notifier/email.py` now checks `NOTIFIER_FF_NEW_RECEIPT_EMAIL`. When it is `"1"`, the function renders `receipt_v2`. When it is unset or anything else, it renders `receipt` as before. The flag follows the notifier's convention: an env var read with `os.environ.get(...) == "1"`, because the notifier can't read the root `flags.toml`. The tests pass, including a new one for the flag-on path.

- **The new template doesn't exist yet.** I found no new receipt template or `templates/` directory in the repo, so I used `receipt_v2` as a placeholder name. Per the notifier convention, you'll need `templates/receipt_v2.mjml` plus a plain-text `receipt_v2.txt` with the same snake_case variables. Tell me if the new email should have a different name. I can also draft the templates if you want.
- **Rollout is on or off per deployment.** The flag is all-or-nothing for each deployed environment. If you want a percentage rollout, we'd need a bucketing rule such as a hash of the invoice or customer id. Say if you want that added.
